plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.repeatable_tail: db2 TAB exact-catalog-name TAB exact-FDID LF; alphabetical names, unique IDs
plan.offmesh_connections: Field must be absent; even an empty offmesh selection is unsupported.
plan.component_scope: Exactly DB2, resident, no map-domain/offmesh/terrain/navigation/GT/cameras; explicit Linux build70450 product16 only

identities.plan: SHA-256 of the complete canonical TSV bytes
identities.source: SHA-256(forever-logical-collection-v1 NUL + build little-endian u32 + build key + CDN key + locale ASCII + ENCODING content key + ROOT content key)
identities.source_scope: authenticated logical collection; not physical archive availability, encryption-key discovery or a complete archive snapshot; every read still requires complete content MD5; provided keys do not change logical content identity; MD5 integrity is not a MAC or trusted provenance
identities.keys: Key names, values, counts, hashes and input paths are excluded from CLI JSON, plans, package context and manifests. Capability is bound by the complete canonical plan SHA-256; this profile forbids provided keys.
identities.schema_catalog: This profile binds its exact schema-catalog id in the complete canonical plan SHA-256; older profiles retain their own catalog identities and canonical plan bytes.

limits.db2_regular_sections: For catalog DB2 sources with more than one section, the existing bounded catalog reader admits 2..16 regular sections; ordinary selected sources use the strict catalog decoder. No rows or partial table are published.
limits.db2_string_validation: The existing catalog raw-source fallback for invalid UTF-8 still validates complete regular-string pointer/NUL framing and cumulative source-byte limits without returning decoded rows; all other validation errors remain fatal.
limits.full_source_decode: Every selected DB2 FDID uses LocalStore's strict full-file decode route with disabled keys. A frame-encrypted DB2 source that cannot be decoded without a key fails with local_store_no_verified_encoding; other source errors also remain fatal under their existing codes. This error is never relaxed into an omission.

resume: Explicit same-context only; verified sealed components skipped; entire unfinished producer reruns and replays retained artifacts; complete output refuses writes; keys are forbidden and no key input is required; every unfinished acquired object must still match the same selected complete CKey; sealed producers are verified and skipped.

verification.db2: Complete bounded validation against the plan-bound wowdbdefs-70450-v1 catalog and exact selected name set; verify-links follows the same selected DB2-only package traversal. Verification does not acquire the client source or prove source availability.
not_claimed: all 1161 tables acquired by a selected plan
frame-encrypted or otherwise unavailable DB2 sources
verification.metadata_preflight: Complete exact selected DB2 names, nonempty files<=16MiB, sum<=16GiB before first artifact payload hash/read/allocation; verify-links applies the same DB2-only package traversal; --keys is forbidden for verify and verify-links.

failure: Stable path-free code and component; incomplete outputs retained; no available-prefix, native, network, missing-file or encrypted-source fallback.

forbidden_for: all v16 client commands because decryption is disabled

failure_envelope: forever-product-v16 after valid plan admission; generic CLI/plan failures before admission retain forever-product-v1; all errors path-free
scope: Explicit Linux build70450 DB2-only target-catalog publication/recovery. No other components, standalone70450, native product, Windows, collision/VMaps, full-world or runtime acceptance.

legacy_preservation.global_SUPPORTED_CLIENTS: 70170,70205,70338 unchanged; 70450 remains absent and is available only through scoped Linux product admission

admission.metadata: admit_db2_70450: exact70450 typed bounded build metadata before bootstrap
admission.store: LocalStore::open_db2_70450; observed build equality fatal on change
admission.raw_store_scope: authenticated generic FDID bytes, not component acceptance; product driver enforces exact target DB2 catalog
admission.platform: Linux only before client/output IO; keys are rejected before key input
admission.package_context: 70450 admits only Linux DB2 mask 1 for v16 and collision mask 16 for the unchanged v15; the complete plan SHA-256 binds the exact revision
